column2: How do I make candlesticks with the births, deaths or marriages in my database?
column3: New diagram → “🕯 Candlesticks” → the “From the app” tab → “Chart”: “Births per year”, “Deaths per year” or “Marriages per year”. Each candle is a decade: the number for the first year (open), the one for the last year (close), the lowest year and the highest. A very tall wick in the deaths shows a crisis year. Known wars and epidemics are added as bands. Everything stays editable in the “Data” tab.
